rule: addendum UPDATE 13: generalization_score = PR_AUC_mean - 0.5 * PR_AUC_std + 0.1 * Recall@100. Applied only within a 0.01 PR-AUC band of the leader; inside that band the simpler and more stable model wins.
eligibility_rule: A candidate is promotable only if it can score one account inside 5.0s. Accuracy does not override this: a score an analyst cannot get in time is not a product. Families with no measured latency stay eligible - an unmeasured cost is recorded as unknown, never assumed.

excluded_for_serving_cost.note: scored higher than the promoted model and was not beaten on accuracy; it is benched on serving cost
